claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the mascara for lengthening and volumizing lashes, often describing a dramatic, full look.
Many customers highlight that it does not smudge, flake, or run, with several calling it a no-panda-eye formula that lasts all day.
Users commonly describe the product as easy to apply and easy to use overall.
A few reviewers report clumping or dry texture, and one notes it is difficult to remove.
Several customers say it performs as well as or better than more expensive brands and consider it good value.
